freeze_rule: AIFC v1.0 MUST NOT be labeled FROZEN unless every required check has machine-verifiable PASS evidence, every evidence hash resolves to exact preserved bytes, the out-of-tree AIFC/release-manifest/v1 verifies against an immutable source commit, and the release record binds the manifest content hash.
forbidden_shortcuts: manual override of failed conformance gate
dropping attack vectors from the frozen corpus after observing failures
using one implementation twice as independent implementations
claiming canonical equivalence without byte-identical test-vector results
claiming complete reporting without a verified global trial ledger and publication manifest
starting candidate production before an experiment plan and CREATED slot are certified
declaring K_i=1 without resolving the frozen candidate set and candidate-generation provenance
allowing post-CREATED operator generator choice in strongest-grade v1
reconstructing or sanitizing the conditioning view after target observation
trusting a producer-selected future event without deterministic target-selector replay
choosing or ambiguously encoding target transformation after target observation
selecting an entropy/security justification after observing the target
accepting dangling or syntactically plausible evidence hashes without resolver verification
reconfiguring witness membership without a connected jointly certified registry transition
counting multiple witness IDs in one failure domain as independent quorum members
accepting mathematically equivalent but byte-noncanonical rational bounds
using the fixed-horizon product formula outside its frozen theorem conditions
placing a release manifest inside the source commit whose SHA it claims to bind
setting FROZEN_PASS without resolving every required gate evidence object
